posts.text: So what happened today? Where to start? The conference officially finished on Friday, but on Saturday dragged on with continually shelved promises of a new draft cover text. The youth NGOs have just taken the floor with some strong words for the presidency. “You have let us down,” they said. “We refuse to bear the consequences of your lack of ambition,” they said, adding that the summit resulted in “no ambition, no consensus, no future”.
